purpose: Representative workload-specific comparisons. Run only after the functional router passes integration tests.

cases.packet:
OBJECTIVE
Inventory the repository by file type and identify generated or vendored areas.

SCOPE
Read-only repository scan.

RELEVANT FILES / PATHS
Repository root.

KNOWN FACTS
Return distilled counts, not raw file contents.

CONSTRAINTS
Do not edit files. Do not include secrets or giant logs.

QUALITY BAR / RISK
Mechanical, low risk, exact counts where tools can establish them.

EXPECTED OUTPUT
A concise report containing the headings SUMMARY, COUNTS, and EXCLUSIONS.

DEFINITION OF DONE
Counts are internally consistent and exclusions are explicit.

VERIFICATION
Recount with deterministic file listing commands.

OBJECTIVE
Create a polished promotional-video concept from repository assets.

SCOPE
Concept, narrative, shot plan, and production handoff only.

RELEVANT FILES / PATHS
Repository assets and existing product documentation.

KNOWN FACTS
Asset discovery and rendering should be routed separately through tools or cheaper workers.

CONSTRAINTS
Do not edit or render. Do not invent assets.

QUALITY BAR / RISK
Strong creative judgment; ordinary reversible planning.

EXPECTED OUTPUT
A concise concept, beat sheet, asset map, and verification plan.

DEFINITION OF DONE
The concept is executable using only evidenced assets.

VERIFICATION
Manual creative-quality review.

OBJECTIVE
Refactor one duplicated implementation path while preserving behavior.

SCOPE
Only files explicitly identified by the parent.

RELEVANT FILES / PATHS
To be supplied by the benchmark maintainer.

KNOWN FACTS
The desired behavior already has deterministic tests.

CONSTRAINTS
Preserve public interfaces and unrelated code.

QUALITY BAR / RISK
Ordinary production-quality implementation.

EXPECTED OUTPUT
Code change plus concise summary.

DEFINITION OF DONE
Existing and targeted tests pass.

VERIFICATION
Run the targeted deterministic test command.

OBJECTIVE
Find and fix an intermittent duplicate-session bug without invalidating existing sessions.

SCOPE
Authentication and session lifecycle paths only.

RELEVANT FILES / PATHS
To be supplied by the benchmark maintainer.

KNOWN FACTS
The failure is intermittent and likely concurrency-related.

CONSTRAINTS
Preserve existing sessions and public auth behavior.

QUALITY BAR / RISK
Correctness-sensitive, substantial root-cause reasoning.

EXPECTED OUTPUT
Evidence-backed root cause, minimal fix, and regression tests.

DEFINITION OF DONE
The race is reproduced or otherwise proven, fixed, and covered.

VERIFICATION
Targeted concurrency and regression tests.

OBJECTIVE
Review an authentication or migration change for exploitable correctness and security failures.

SCOPE
Read-only review of the supplied change and affected trust boundaries.

RELEVANT FILES / PATHS
To be supplied by the benchmark maintainer.

KNOWN FACTS
False negatives are materially costly.

CONSTRAINTS
Cite evidence. Separate confirmed findings from hypotheses.

QUALITY BAR / RISK
Security-sensitive and quality-first with a large confidence margin.

EXPECTED OUTPUT
Prioritized findings, evidence, exploit path, and verification steps.

DEFINITION OF DONE
Every material trust boundary is assessed and uncertainty is explicit.

VERIFICATION
Independent strong-model review plus deterministic tests where applicable.
